title: What If You Drove to the Sun at 60 Miles an Hour?

scenes.text: What if you drove to the Sun at highway speed? The trip would outlast you.
The Sun is about 93 million miles away. Hold sixty miles an hour and never stop.
That is 1,440 miles a day, and about 525,600 miles a year.
At that pace, the drive takes about 176 years.
Leave today and you would arrive in the early 2200s, with the wheel passed through several generations.
A car that left in the year 1850 would only be arriving about now.
